query: I'm evaluating an 82-year-old woman; among females aged 77–87, what is the IQR of first-admission length of stay in days?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY los) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY los)) AS interquartile_range FROM admissions_77_87 UNION ALL SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY los) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY los)) AS interquartile_range FROM admissions_82;
